card.title: Nintendo 3DS

claims.statement: On 3DS, applying battery/charger power boots the MCU, which initialises I2C, reads config resistors, configures regulators, detects charger and runs battery rejection—before any power button press.

On power button press the MCU re-checks the battery (emergency shutdown if rejected), fades in the LED, powers the SoC and releases resets; the bootroms then find a boot device or show the blue screen.
Original 3DS differs significantly from the New 3DS; the 2DS shares nearly all original 3DS parts.

card.caveats: Reference card, no fault procedure. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
